defects.finding: The unscoped ME text selector matched unrelated task and appliance text. The current recipe selects Me inside the visible Chores scope segment.
defects.resolution: Use the source-identified All/Me scope segment and assert the resulting local scope state.

defects.finding: The icon-only geometric slot did not identify the delivery history owner in the dashboard layout.
defects.resolution: Scroll to the visible tap / hold delivery helper and long-press its source-owned calendar/history control.

defects.finding: The old icon slot did not bind the add action to the Automations card header.
defects.resolution: Scroll to Automations and activate its visible trailing header control.

defects.finding: The old icon slot did not bind the add action to the Appliance Watch card header.
defects.resolution: Scroll to Appliance Watch and activate its visible trailing header control.

defects.finding: The generic Reschedule label did not prove which visible chore row owned the action; initial row text also needed a render wait.
defects.resolution: Wait for Water Front Plants, swipe that row, and select Reschedule by matching its visible row bounds.

defects.finding: R6 selected unassigned Empty Kitchen Trash while its swipe evidence named assigned Water Front Plants; after opening the game option, label evidence was read after it changed.
defects.resolution: Select and swipe the assigned Water Front Plants row, scope Reassign to that row, then capture label evidence before activation.

defects.finding: The accepted action embedded a seeded completed count and the runner tried to read the label after activation changed it.
defects.resolution: Match the current visible Show completed (N) label and record it before clicking.

defects.finding: Clicking nested Sarah Kim text was intercepted by the focusable profile card hit target.
defects.resolution: Activate the visible Sarah Kim profile-card Pressable with its normal keyboard Enter interaction.

defects.finding: The visible Show more count is dynamic and the runner attempted to read the old label after expansion.
defects.resolution: Match the current Show more · N more control and record its label before activation.

defects.finding: Create Fund changed the visible form state; the runner read the button label after activation and stopped before the next valid action.
defects.resolution: Record Create Fund before activation, wait for form completion, then open Contribute Points without submitting.

defects.finding: The old scroll-anchor evidence parser could not recover Point History, the placeholder action omitted its fill value, and the ready check treated an input value as page text.
defects.resolution: Anchor directly to Point History, visibly fill R5 no match, and assert the textbox value plus the source-defined empty state.

defects.finding: The old disposable row name did not match the current recipe fixture and the current form defaults to Fixed days, requiring a normal visible Never selection.
defects.resolution: Create R1 Disposable Market Item with Limited stock 1 and visibly choose Never expiry before Add to Market.

defects.finding: The old disposable row name did not match the current recipe fixture and the current form defaults to Fixed days, requiring a normal visible Never selection.

defects.finding: The old long-press helper split Movie Night and acted on the last word Night; the follow-up label was also read after the menu changed.
defects.resolution: Long-press the full visible Movie Night label and record Price History before activation.

defects.finding: An unscoped 150 price text could resolve to another card and did not establish the Movie Night redemption intent.
defects.resolution: Select the visible 150-point control scoped to the Movie Night reward card.

defects.finding: The generic Edit selector resolved to a different off-viewport control instead of the Family Hub header action.
defects.resolution: Scroll Family Hub into view and activate the Edit control anchored to that header.

defects.finding: Current recipe adaptation left the visible text anchor empty when AR-85 described the Chore Heatmap card only in free-form evidence.
defects.resolution: Anchor directly to the visible Chore Heatmap heading and then assert 52 weeks of family activity.

defects.finding: The formerly named Sleep In Day reward is expired under the current deterministic runtime. The same active-use confirmation renderer remains available for Pizza Night.
defects.resolution: Open Use from the currently active Pizza Night card and assert Use "Pizza Night"?.

defects.finding: Current owner source renders HISTORY (N), while the accepted recipe searched for exact History.
defects.resolution: Match the current visible HISTORY (N) section label and record it before activation.
